pass_group.method: There are no separate PASS-group repositories. These are the user-supplied Correct items inside the SAME seven defect repositories at the SAME pinned SHAs. Each emitted finding is reviewed against these items. The allowed finding patterns below record non-conflicting defect claims, not runtime rule exceptions. Any unreviewed/new finding fails this false-flag gate pending review.

AP2171W with R11 pull-down / R12 pull-up
firmware PB0/PB1 buttons / PA7 buzzer / PA1/PA2 LIN UART / PA4/PA5 debug UART

firmware LED / mic I2S / speaker I2S and enable / touch / UART / native USB pins match hardware

MAX98357 NC pins and gain resistor
SW3 EN pull-up and RC delay

findings.summary: Q1: base B is grounded while emitter E is driven through a resistor by U3 GPIO14/TOUCH14/ADC2_CH3/FSPIWP/FSPIDQS/SUBSPIWP. This reverses the usual low-side switch drive and cannot forward-bias an NPN base-emitter junction from a positive GPIO. Connect emitter to GND and drive base through the resistor after verifying transistor polarity.
